answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 12464 Country: India Title: Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. She is crying and does not want to hit him but she is continuing to hit him. Due to some reason, she is unable to stop hitting him. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. Question: Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. Answer ID: 12464 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1061/832=H/1430) Both the dreams are nice. It means that the elder son shall get much benefit from the du?a and upbringing of both of you (parents), in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
